title: submit_delete_account clears the inputs, resets the stage and drops the send error
trigger: Open Account box, type the 2FA password and a reason, arm Delete, press Alright delete while chats_path_active() is false or a TTL write is pending (delete_account returns Err(InvalidRequest))
effect: The password and reason are wiped, the confirm banner collapses to Open and no note is shown; the user believes the deletion started or has to retype everything
fix: Match the Result of driver.delete_account: only on Ok clear inputs and leave ConfirmDelete (AccountOp::Mutating(id) shows the progress); on Err keep ConfirmDelete and set an error note

title: PermissionAsk::Asking sticks when the asking window closes or the screen goes before the system prompt is answered; the poll task is detached
trigger: macOS: press Call or record in a chat window while the camera/microphone is undetermined, close that chat window (or switch account away and back is fine, OnScreen is replaced) before answering the prompt, then answer it
effect: the task's update is refused (ScopedApp::update returns Gone), so recording.permission is never reset to Idle; every later press that needs an undetermined device returns silently at `permission != Idle`: Call, Answer, camera toggle and voice record do nothing until the screen is replaced. The 100 ms poll task also runs until the prompt is answered
fix: Hold the poll Task inside PermissionAsk::Asking {id, call, task} (dropping the stage drops the task), and end the stage from the window-close and screen-farewell paths; or resolve the answer with a channel the stage owns

title: Event log treats ChatEventLogFetch::Idle as Loading: a refresh or first open whose send fails leaves Idle and a spinner forever, retry only shows on Failed
trigger: Open Recent actions while the sender is closed / chats_path inactive, or Save a filter / search when send_json errors (driver resets fetch to Idle and returns Err)
effect: 'Loading recent actions' spinner never ends; the note is the only trace; closing and reopening the page is the only way out
fix: on send error set ChatEventLogFetch::Failed(msg) so the Retry button shows; render Idle as a request to send, not as Loading

title: Gift Premium or Stars box draws no loading or failed state for the contacts it waits on
trigger: open the box with live driver; fetch_contacts is sent but answers Failed (or is still Loading); the top-chats fetch result is dropped with let _
effect: the box shows only the search field and Cancel, identical to 'nobody to gift'; Failed is treated as loaded and offers no Retry (reopen is the only way)
fix: draw Fetch<contacts> stage: spinner while Loading, error line with Retry (load_gift_recipients) on Failed

title: open_group_call_invite ignores the unlock answer and opens the box and fetches contacts under the passcode lock
trigger: Lock the app while a call window is up, click Invite Members
effect: call_box becomes Invite and fetch_contacts is sent while locked; the box is undrawn until unlock, then appears (open_group_call_share_links returns on the same check)
fix: return when group_call_needs_unlock is true, as the share opener does

title: Member list draws 'Loading members' forever when the page request could not be sent
trigger: Open Manage members (or switch tab / press Search) while the driver refuses the send (chats path inactive, sender closed): refresh_supergroup_members removes the cached page, fetch_supergroup_members removes the Loading entry and member_asks on Err, refresh_member_dialog also overwrites dialog.searched
effect: List shows 'Loading members...' with no Retry (Retry exists only on Failed); a note appeared once but the stage is lost. Same for basic groups (fetch_basic_group_members removes the entry on Err)
fix: Record the refused send as SupergroupMembersFetch::Failed(reason) instead of removing the entry, and treat None as Idle (send from the opener), not as Loading

title: start_invoice_checkout resets checkout, order_info, shipping_id and note by hand, duplicating Session::close_checkout (which also clears request)
trigger: Press Buy on an invoice while another checkout is on screen or after a paid one
effect: Four fields of one mode cleared from UI code; a new field added to close_checkout is missed here; request is left to the sender and stays stale if the send errors, so submit_stars_payment can later find a request with a Closed checkout
fix: Call one Session::begin_checkout() that replaces the whole checkout stage (request, form, order info, shipping, note) as one enum value

title: A refused getGameHighScores leaves the scores panel drawing 'Loading scores...' for ever, with no error and no Retry
trigger: Tap Scores on a game card when the request is refused (a status note shows)
effect: The panel keeps the spinner text; a second tap closes it and a third retries, which nothing tells the user. Section 8 (11-p3-004) says Failed is drawn with Retry; the panel only matches data() None as loading
fix: draw Fetch::Failed with its error and a Retry button; match on the Fetch variant, not data()

title: Confirming Unpin clears the window's whole forward stage, even when the unpin is from the message menu and the forward is unrelated
trigger: Build a forward (messages ticked, or the forward bar above a composer), right-click a pinned message, Unpin, OK
effect: share.forward is set to ForwardStage::None: the ticked messages or the pending forward bar are lost
fix: Clear the forward only when the unpin came from that selection (selection_bar), by passing the origin to confirm_unpin

title: Tray media check and file thumbnail reads (and their 15 s give-up timers) are window/screen-scoped but settle app-level TrayReads, so Reading can stick
trigger: Attach a photo or video, or a picture sent as a file, then close the chat window that started the read or switch account before it lands; reopen that tray
effect: Both the worker continuation and the GIVE_UP_AFTER timer are spawn_scoped(...).detach() and return Gone, so Reads::media / Reads::thumbnails keep Reading{job}; tray_media_checks_pending / tray_thumbnails_pending stay true and Send is refused with 'Preparing the files' until the attachment is removed
fix: Same as c0-001: the Reading stage owns its Task and timer (Reading{job, task}) so the owner dropping them ends the stage; or spawn_app work that always settles

title: Engine install re-seeds underlines.text and schedules a check even with spell check off; turning it on later never checks the draft
trigger: Spell check is off, a draft sits in a composer, the background engine build finishes (install_spell_engine sets spelling.underlines.text = draft and calls schedule_spellcheck, whose answer is dropped because spellcheck_enabled is false); the user switches Check spelling on: sync_spellcheck_everywhere -> sync_spellcheck sees text == underlines.text && non-empty and returns early without scheduling
effect: No underlines appear for the existing draft until the next edit; also a wasted background check while the setting is off
fix: install_spell_engine (and recheck_spelling) go through the same disabled gate as sync_spellcheck, or sync_spellcheck decides 'already checked' from Check/Underlines state (an Underlines { text, status: Unchecked|Checked } value) instead of text equality

title: A failed first page of Money history has no Retry
trigger: History request answers with an error (network, wallet server) on Transactions tab
effect: Paged::Failed{shown:None} draws only the error line; Load more is drawn only when has_more() (needs a shown page) and set_money_tab refetches only Collectibles, so the Transactions list stays failed until the Money box is closed and opened again
fix: Draw a Retry button for Paged::Failed (calls fetch_wallet_history(false)/fetch_wallet_nfts(false))

title: Apps tab shows "Loading apps..." for Idle and a dead "Could not load" for Failed
trigger: fetch_grossing_web_app_bots is sent only from set_search_filters(Apps) and its Err is dropped (let _ =, search_ui/mod.rs:867); the send fails, or the first fetch fails.
effect: grossing stays Idle -> text says loading forever; Failed has no retry until the scope chip is chosen again.
fix: Render Fetch::Idle/Failed apart from Loading and give Failed a retry; surface the send error
